concerns.text: T003 requires metrics.json to contain delta_r2, percentage_improvement, sample_size, sampling_method, representativeness_limitation, but the schema declares additionalProperties: false and defines none of these keys. The task's own verification ('validates against the schema') is therefore unsatisfiable as written — a conforming output cannot both include the keys and pass validation. Either the contract must be extended or the keys dropped/moved to a separate artifact.

T003 specifies rmse_percentage_range 'null if test-set range < 1e-6', but the schema types it as required 'number' with no nullable allowance. The null branch fails schema validation, making the edge-case path unexecutable.

T010 requires 'byte-identical metrics.json' on fresh re-run, but T008 mandates recording runtime_seconds in results/metrics.json, and runtime varies between runs. The two verifications are mutually contradictory; specify which fields are compared or exclude runtime_seconds from the byte-identity check.

T002's verify condition demands 'all normalized columns strictly within [0,1]', but min-max normalization deterministically produces exact 0.0 and 1.0 at the min/max training rows. The check can never pass; restate as inclusive [0,1] (matching the dataset schema's inclusive bounds) or clip/justify.

T002 bundles ~7 distinct deliverables (N-validation, zero-variance/VIF handling, source-independence script, scope detection, imputation, encoding, split, scaling, 5+ output artifacts) into one task. Too coarse for deterministic execution — split so each artifact/error-path has its own verifiable unit (the downstream atomizer will otherwise have to guess the boundaries).

T003 similarly spans wiring main.py, GPR training, baseline, metrics computation, model serialization, and reproducibility re-run. Coarse; at minimum separate the pipeline wiring from the reproducibility (seed-42 identical-output) verification, which has a different failure mode.

T004's missing-baseline fallback (CV-fold stability analysis, log 'Partially Met') contradicts plan T031 ('If neither exists, skip correlation'). An implementer following the plan will skip; one following tasks will build the stability analysis. Pick one behavior and state it in both artifacts.

Sparse-GPR trigger conditions differ between plan (N>500 or heteroscedasticity) and T008 (memory ≥ 7340 MB or N>500). The task is executable but the implementer cannot know which trigger set is authoritative; also the plan's '< 6 GB' goal is never enforced by T008's 7340 MB threshold.
